title: 第7章 一招败敌

content_zh:
“没有亲帖，就不能来参加选婚大会，这规矩是你定的？难道你萧腾，已经自傲到不把三位村长，放在眼中？”萧叶声音逐渐变冷。
“你！”萧腾呼吸一滞，满脸恼怒。
虽然选婚之前，有着送亲帖的习俗，但是的确没有规定，男方没有亲帖就不能参加选婚。
而且三位德高望重的村长都在现场，他如果继续反击下去，岂不是坐实了不尊长辈的名头？
萧叶冷冷扫了他一眼，随后对三位村长躬身行礼：“村长爷爷，吴爷爷，石爷爷。”
“萧腾，你下去吧。”萧天雄面色不善的说道。
他很失望，因为萧腾为人太过浮躁，以后难成大器。想到自己千辛万苦弄来的蛟蛇血，浪费在这样的人身上，萧天雄感到一阵不甘。
“叶儿，只能怪你苏醒太晚了。”萧天雄暗暗叹息。
“哼！”萧腾冷哼着坐了回去，“选婚比武上，你最好别遇到我，否则我一定要你好看！”
随便鞭炮声响起，年关的聚餐开始了。
青阳镇中心广场，放眼望去，至少安排了数千张酒席，众人吃吃喝喝，非常的热闹。
大约一个时辰后，待众人吃饱喝足，一位中年人登上了中心的擂台上。
萧叶抬头望去，发现正是他们村子的小辈教头萧大山。
“大家静静，接下来就是大家期待已久的选婚大赛了，请参加选婚的女方，都走出来吧。”萧大山朗声道。
顿时，一位位穿着喜庆红袍的少女出现，莺莺燕燕，眼含羞意，走到擂台前方。
这些少女当中，又以站在队伍最前方的吴媚儿，最为引人注意。单单她一人，就吸引了大部分少年的目光。
“我靠，你真恶心，居然流口水了！”
“没办法，谁让吴媚儿那么漂亮，我要是能把她娶回家，少活十年也甘心啊！”
这句话一出口，顿时引得了哄堂大笑。
“十年？你也太贪心了，要是我就少活二十年。”又一位少年开口，将现场的气氛推上了巅峰，爆笑声不断。

萧叶坐在位子上，却不停的吃菜。
他来参加选婚，原本就是为了给萧阳长长脸，他可不想这么早就被婚姻给束缚住。
听着传来的惊叹声，吴媚儿挺了挺发育健全的胸脯，目光扫视全场，如同骄傲的公主。
“哼哼，这帮臭男人，就凭你们还想染指老娘，做梦！”
可当吴媚儿的视线，停留在萧叶身上时，她的表情骤然变了。对方居然连看都不看她，低头在那吃菜。
难道他吴媚儿，还没有一盘菜的吸引力大？
“萧叶，我一定要让腾哥揍死你！”对方的这般无视，让吴媚儿气得直咬牙。
“我宣布，选婚大会正式开始！”萧大山大声道，然后从怀中拿出一份名单，“下面我会根据这份名单点名，点到名字的两位少年可以随意施展手脚，但是切记不可伤人。”
接着，萧大山说了下擂台比武的流程。
萧叶还是第一次参加选婚，他仔细倾听，心中恍然。
这次参加选婚的少年一共有六百五十五位，除却收到亲帖最多的五人外，剩下的六百五十位少年，需要经过数轮混战，选出一人进入决赛。
这个规矩在青阳镇已经流传数百年了，本来也没有多大的漏洞。因为女方选择送亲帖的对象，都是选择实力强的。让实力强的少年参加混战，这显然不合理。
但是这次，众人的神情却古怪起来，然后偏头看向萧叶。
在众人心中，虽然萧叶已经不是萧家村第一天才，但是他的资质是不容置疑的，在整个青阳镇的同辈中，也是出类拔萃的存在。
如果不是因为他意外昏迷，绝对会收到较多的亲帖，就算无法和萧腾相比，却一定可以成为那五人之一。
“叶儿，你行吗？”萧阳有些担忧道。
就算萧叶能通过混战进入决赛，那时候也会消耗过大，难以发挥出巅峰的实力，所以萧阳有些担忧。
“爹娘，你们放心吧。”萧叶自信满满，心中滋生一股豪气。
不就是六百五十人吗？大不了一路打上去，惊爆所有人的眼球，这样的方式，应该足够给父母长脸的了吧。
想到这里，萧叶嘿嘿笑了起来。

那些轻视我的人啊，这次你们就好好看着吧。
“上虎座！”擂台上的萧大山一挥手，顿时有着六位大汉搬着六张虎皮大椅，放在擂台前的空地上，一字排开，气势非凡。

content_en:
"You can't come to the marriage selection meeting without a wedding invitation. Are you the one who made this rule? Are you, Xiao Teng, so proud that you don't take the three village chiefs seriously?" Xiao Ye's voice gradually became colder.
"You!" Xiao Teng's breath was stagnant, his face full of anger.
Although there is a custom of sending wedding invitations before marriage, there is no rule that a man cannot participate in marriage selection without a marriage invitation.
Moreover, three highly respected village chiefs were present at the scene. If he continued to fight back, wouldn't he be establishing his reputation as disrespecting his elders?
Xiao Ye glanced at him coldly, and then bowed to the three village chiefs: "Grandpa Village Chief, Grandpa Wu, Grandpa Shi."
"Xiao Teng, go down." Xiao Tianxiong said with an unkind expression.
He was very disappointed because Xiao Teng was too impetuous and would never become a great person in the future. Xiao Tianxiong felt unwilling to think that the snake blood he had worked so hard to obtain was wasted on such a person.
"Ye'er, I can only blame you for waking up too late." Xiao Tianxiong sighed secretly.
"Hmph!" Xiao Teng snorted coldly and sat back, "You'd better not meet me in the marriage competition, otherwise I will make you look good!"
The sound of firecrackers rang out casually, and the New Year's Eve dinner began.
Looking at the central square of Qingyang Town, there are at least thousands of banquets arranged, and everyone is eating and drinking, which is very lively.
About an hour later, after everyone had eaten and drank, a middle-aged man stepped onto the ring in the center.
Xiao Ye looked up and found that it was Xiao Dashan, the junior coach of their village.
"Everyone, be quiet. Next is the marriage selection contest that everyone has been waiting for. All women participating in the marriage selection please come forward." Xiao Dashan said loudly.
Suddenly, girls in festive red robes appeared one after another, walking to the front of the ring with shy eyes.
Among these girls, Wu Meier, who stood at the front of the team, attracted the most attention. She alone attracted the attention of most teenagers.
"Holy shit, you're so disgusting, you're actually drooling!"
"I can't help it. Who made Wu Mei'er so beautiful? If I could marry her home, I would be willing to live ten years shorter!"
As soon as this sentence came out, it immediately caused a roar of laughter.
"Ten years? You are too greedy. If I were to live, my life would be shortened by twenty years." Another young man spoke, pushing the atmosphere of the scene to its peak, and bursts of laughter continued.
Xiao Ye sat on his seat but kept eating.
He came to participate in the marriage selection originally just to make Henry Zhang look good. He didn't want to be bound by marriage so early.
Listening to the exclamations, Wu Meier straightened her well-developed breasts and scanned the audience like a proud princess.
"Hmph, these stinky men, just because you want to get your hands on me, you're just dreaming!"
But when Wu Meier's eyes rested on Xiao Ye, her expression suddenly changed. The other party didn't even look at her, he just lowered his head and ate the food.
Could it be that Wu Meier is not as attractive as a plate of food?
"Xiao Ye, I must let Brother Teng beat you to death!" The other party's such disregard made Wu Meier grit her teeth in anger.
"I declare that the marriage selection meeting has officially begun!" Xiao Dashan said loudly, and then took out a list from his arms, "I will call the names based on this list. The two young men whose names are called can use their hands and feet as they please, but remember not to hurt anyone."
Then, Xiao Dashan explained the process of the competition in the ring.
This was Xiao Ye's first time participating in a marriage selection. He listened carefully and felt enlightened.
There are a total of 655 young people participating in the marriage selection this time. Except for the five people who have received the most wedding invitations, the remaining 650 young people need to go through several rounds of melee to select one person to enter the finals.
This rule has been circulating in Qingyang Town for hundreds of years, and there were no big loopholes in it. Because the woman chooses to send wedding invitations to someone who is strong. It is obviously unreasonable to let strong young people participate in melee.
But this time, everyone's expressions became strange, and then they turned their heads to look at Xiaoleaf.
In the hearts of everyone, although Xiao Ye is no longer the number one genius in Xiaojia Village, his qualifications are unquestionable and he is also outstanding among his peers in Qingyang Town.
If it weren't for his accidental coma, he would definitely have received more invitations. Even if he couldn't compare with Xiao Teng, he would definitely be one of the five people.
"Ye'er, are you okay?" Henry Zhang said worriedly.
Even if Xiao Ye can enter the finals through melee, the consumption will be too high at that time and it will be difficult to exert his peak strength, so Xiao Yang is a little worried.
"Mom and dad, don't worry." Xiao Ye was full of confidence and a sense of pride grew in his heart.
Isn’t that six hundred and fifty people? At worst, he could fight all the way up and shock everyone's attention. This method should be enough to make his parents look good.
Thinking of this, Xiao Ye laughed.
Those who despise me, please watch carefully this time.
"Get on the tiger seat!" Xiao Dashan waved his hand on the ring, and suddenly there were six big men carrying six big tiger leather chairs and placing them on the open space in front of the ring, lined up in a row, with extraordinary momentum.
